title: panel-feedback-and-buddy-retro-may06-2025
summary: Combined notes from two touching items: (1) interview panel debriefs for three backend/SRE candidates and decision guidance; (2) first-batch onboarding buddy retro (Week 0-2) and quick wins for ramp and team health.
meeting_notes:
Interview debriefs (May 2, 2025):

Candidate A — backend infra (external hire):
- Panel composition: Liam (tech lead), Diego (SRE), Priya (onboarding + culture).
- Strengths: strong systems design, clear on KV cache tradeoffs, good perf debugging examples.
- Concerns: limited exposure to large-scale continuous batching systems (no direct product examples), some ambiguity in testing approach for performance regressions.
- Rating (consensus): 7/10. Recommended: hire as IC3 with a 6-month performance ramp plan focusing on continuous batching ownership.
- Follow-ups: request small design take-home (2–3 day) focused on caching fallback policy; Asha to send by 2025-05-09.

Candidate B — SRE / infra (internal ref):
- Panel: Diego, Sana, Priya.
- Strengths: operational runbook experience, incident postmortem writes up nicely, internal domain knowledge.
- Concerns: some gaps in kernel-level optimization familiarity (GPU inference stack). Potential training cost but strong cultural fit.
- Rating: 8/10. Recommended: proceed to final onsite + leadership bar.
- Follow-ups: Diego to draft a short shadow-on-call plan and present to hiring committee by 2025-05-12 (JIRA-ENG-1589).

Candidate C — platform tooling (contract-to-hire):
- Panel: Sana, Liam.
- Strengths: pragmatic automation, strong owner mentality, delivered a previous small observability tool chain.
- Concerns: subtle mismatch on scale expectations for our Dedicated product (hasn't run at our expected throughput); would need mentorship.
- Rating: 6/10. Recommended: consider 6-month contract with a clear success criteria (metrics around delivery + integration tests).

Panel consensus notes:
- Overall pipeline quality remains decent but skewed slightly junior for the mid-Senior roles we need for Dedicated launch. Need more targeted sourcing from candidates with production batching/quantization experience.
- Interview calibration: panels diverged on perf / kernel questions; propose adding a short standardized perf-question rubric for panels (see linked Confluence).

Onboarding buddy retro (May 5, 2025):
- Scope: feedback collected from 5 new hires who started between Apr 14–28 and their buddies (serving-runtime and platform-eng grads).
- What worked:
  - Buddy pairing matched domain interest (e.g., SRE buddy for infra hires) — reduced first-week confusion.
  - 'Starter deck' (internal slides) helped new hires run a micro-runbook within 3 days.
  - Weekly 1:1 with manager recommended cadence is working (first two weeks).
- Pain points:
  - Onboarding safety: some new hires reported unclear escalation path for perf incidents during shadowing. Need explicit on-call shadow checklist.
  - Ramp visibility: managers report difficulty measuring feature-complete progress vs. operational readiness.
  - Documentation gaps: three places where playbooks are stale (KV cache invalidation, batch sizing guidelines, model version pinning).
- Team health signals observed:
  - Small but notable fatigue in serving-runtime on-call rotation for two engineers who covered multiple incidents in Apr.
  - Positive: high engagement in cross-team pairing sessions; new hires appreciate short pairing blocks rather than long stretches.

Informal notes / other context:
- We had a side conversation about prioritizing quantization exposure in hiring descriptions; agreed to call this out explicitly for mid-senior infra roles.
- Asha recommended a mini-bootcamp for new hires (2 half-days) focused on our runtime bottlenecks and observability stack.
- Slack thread captured initial panel comments: slack:#hiring-panel (see linked_artifacts).
action_items: Asha: Send Candidate A take-home design brief by 2025-05-09 (linked to JIRA-ENG-1423)
Diego: Draft on-call shadow plan for Candidate B + present to hiring committee by 2025-05-12
Sana: Update onboarding playbooks for KV cache, batch sizing, and model pinning; target doc updates by 2025-05-20
Liam: Work with docs to add a short perf-question rubric to Confluence ("Interview Guide v2") by 2025-05-13
Priya: Pilot 2x half-day runtime bootcamp for latest cohort on 2025-05-22 and collect feedback
People Ops: Add explicit escalation path to the starter deck and distribute to buddies by 2025-05-14
hiring_pipeline_snapshot: Active roles: 6 (3 backend infra, 1 SRE senior, 2 platform tools). Stage breakdown: sourcing 2, phone screens 3, onsites 1. Time-to-offer median last quarter: 34 days. Gap: need +2 mid-senior infra candidates with quantization/continuous-batching experience.
onboarding_buddy_feedback: High-level themes from buddies: keep pairing short (2–3x 45m blocks/week), introduce 'incident shadow checklist' on day 1, and label docs with freshness dates. Buddies asked for a small stipend for 'onboarding admin' time; People Ops flagged as possible for Q3 pilot.
health_observations: Signals: two engineers in serving-runtime reported >2 high-severity incidents in April; consider temporary rotation relief or overtime budget for May. Overall morale is stable; new hires report good mentorship but want clearer success metrics for 30/60/90 plans. Recommend managers explicitly review 30/60 goals in next manager sync (week of 2025-05-12).
